description: Configuration for dual barcode layout generation - 235×363 array

grid_configuration.comment: Each 4×4 block shares one bar_1, with 16 unique bar_2 assignments

barcode_configuration.comment: Each final barcode is bar_1(18nt) + bar_2(18nt) = 36nt total

algorithm.bar_1_assignment: Each 4×4 block receives one shared bar_1 barcode
algorithm.bar_2_assignment: Each position within a block receives a unique bar_2 barcode
algorithm.uniqueness_constraint: Global - no bar_1+bar_2 combination repeats across entire array

notes: Array has 85,305 spots arranged in 235 rows and 363 columns
Organized into 5,369 blocks of 4×4 (some edge blocks have <16 spots)
85,305 barcodes available - sufficient for the required combinations
Each barcode segment is 18nt, final concatenated barcode is 36nt
